form.label: Telemetry Intake Tracker
form.description: Every request saved from the Telemetry Navigator, where it is in the NEHA intake flow, and whether the technologies it asked for are actually arriving in Splunk for that AE. Use the form to move a request to its next status, or to import a request someone sent as Navigator JSON.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_intake_requests_lookup | eval status_order=case(status="Submitted",1, status="Triage",2, status="Approved",3, status="Deferred",4, status="Rejected",5, status="Requirements validated",6, status="Onboarding",7, status="Pipeline validated",8, status="Normalized",9, status="Detections validated",10, status="Monitoring live",11, status="Complete",12, 1=1,0) | eval is_open=if(status IN ("Complete","Rejected"),0,1), target_epoch=strptime(target_date,"%Y-%m-%d"), past_target=if(is_open=1 AND isnotnull(target_epoch) AND target_epoch<relative_time(now(),"@d"),1,0), age_days=round((now()-submitted_at)/86400,0), days_in_status=round((now()-coalesce(status_updated,submitted_at))/86400,0) | eval submitted=strftime(submitted_at,"%Y-%m-%d"), status_since=strftime(coalesce(status_updated,submitted_at),"%Y-%m-%d")
| eval label=request_id." - ".coalesce(system_name,"(unnamed)")." - ".coalesce(ae_name,uhgid,"")." [".status."]" | sort - submitted_at | fields label request_id

| inputlookup dc_intake_requests_lookup where request_id=$req|s$ | eval status=$new_status|s$, status_updated=now(), status_by=$by|s$, status_note=$note|s$, _key=request_id | table _key request_id submitted_at submitted_by status status_updated status_by status_note system_name application_id uhgid ae_name requesting_team data_owner business_unit environment volume_gb_day target_date data_sensitivity regulatory_drivers overlays technologies technology_scopes index_families conditional_triggers standard_version source payload_json | outputlookup append=t dc_intake_requests_lookup | eval status_updated=strftime(status_updated,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table request_id system_name ae_name status status_updated status_by status_note

| makeresults | eval payload=$json|s$ | spath input=payload path=requestId output=request_id | spath input=payload path=system output=system_name | spath input=payload path=applicationId output=application_id | spath input=payload path=uhgid output=uhgid | spath input=payload path=aeName output=ae_name | spath input=payload path=requestingTeam output=requesting_team | spath input=payload path=dataOwner output=data_owner | spath input=payload path=businessUnitOrAE output=business_unit | spath input=payload path=environment output=environment | spath input=payload path=volumeGBPerDay output=volume_gb_day | spath input=payload path=targetOnboardingDate output=target_date | spath input=payload path=dataSensitivity output=data_sensitivity | spath input=payload path=regulatoryDrivers{} output=regulatory_drivers | spath input=payload path=overlays{} output=overlays | spath input=payload path=standard output=standard_version | spath input=payload path=technologies{} output=tech | eval uhgid=lower(trim(uhgid)), technologies=mvjoin(mvmap(tech, spath(tech,"family")),"|"), technology_scopes=mvjoin(mvmap(tech, spath(tech,"family")."=".spath(tech,"scope")),"|"), index_families=mvjoin(mvmap(tech, spath(tech,"family")."=".coalesce(mvjoin(spath(tech,"indexFamilies{}"),","),"")),"|"), conditional_triggers=mvjoin(mvmap(tech, if(isnotnull(spath(tech,"conditionalTriggers{}")), spath(tech,"family")."=".mvjoin(spath(tech,"conditionalTriggers{}"),","), null())),"|"), regulatory_drivers=mvjoin(regulatory_drivers,"|"), overlays=mvjoin(overlays,"|") | lookup dc_datasets_lookup uhgid OUTPUT ae_name as catalog_ae_name | eval ae_name=coalesce(if(ae_name="",null(),ae_name), mvindex(catalog_ae_name,0), "") | lookup dc_intake_requests_lookup request_id OUTPUT status as old_status, submitted_at as old_submitted_at, submitted_by as old_submitted_by, status_updated as old_status_updated, status_by as old_status_by, status_note as old_status_note | eval status=coalesce(old_status,"Submitted"), submitted_at=coalesce(old_submitted_at,now()), submitted_by=coalesce(old_submitted_by,$by|s$), status_updated=coalesce(old_status_updated,now()), status_by=coalesce(old_status_by,$by|s$), status_note=coalesce(old_status_note,""), source="json_import", payload_json=payload, _key=request_id | eval check=case(isnull(request_id) OR request_id="","NOT A NAVIGATOR SUMMARY - nothing will be saved", isnull(technologies) OR technologies="","No technologies selected", isnotnull(old_status),"Updates existing request (status kept: ".old_status.")", 1=1,"New request") | table check request_id system_name uhgid ae_name requesting_team environment target_date technologies technology_scopes overlays index_families

| makeresults | eval payload=$json|s$ | spath input=payload path=requestId output=request_id | where isnotnull(request_id) AND request_id!="" | spath input=payload path=system output=system_name | spath input=payload path=applicationId output=application_id | spath input=payload path=uhgid output=uhgid | spath input=payload path=aeName output=ae_name | spath input=payload path=requestingTeam conditional_triggers=mvjoin(mvmap(tech, if(isnotnull(spath(tech,"conditionalTriggers{}")), spath(tech,"family")."=".mvjoin(spath(tech,"conditionalTriggers{}"),","), null())),"|"), regulatory_drivers=mvjoin(regulatory_drivers,"|"), overlays=mvjoin(overlays,"|") | lookup dc_datasets_lookup uhgid OUTPUT ae_name as catalog_ae_name | eval submitted_by as old_submitted_by, status_updated as old_status_updated, status_by as old_status_by, status_note as old_status_note | eval status=coalesce(old_status,"Submitted"), submitted_at=coalesce(old_submitted_at,now()), submitted_by=coalesce(old_submitted_by,$by|s$), status_updated=coalesce(old_status_updated,now()), status_by=coalesce(old_status_by,$by|s$), status_note=coalesce(old_status_note,""), source="json_import", payload_json=payload, _key=request_id | table _key request_id submitted_at submitted_by status status_updated status_by status_note system_name application_id uhgid ae_name requesting_team data_owner business_unit environment volume_gb_day target_date data_sensitivity regulatory_drivers overlays technologies technology_scopes index_families conditional_triggers standard_version source payload_json | outputlookup append=t dc_intake_requests_lookup | table request_id system_name ae_name status technologies

| sort is_open status_order - submitted_at | table request_id submitted system_name ae_name uhgid requesting_team technologies overlays data_sensitivity status status_since days_in_status target_date past_target submitted_by

panel.title: Requested vs arriving - is each requested technology flowing for that AE?

search.query: | inputlookup dc_intake_requests_lookup | eval uhgid=lower(uhgid), pairs=split(index_families,"|") | mvexpand pairs | eval technology=mvindex(split(pairs,"="),0), fams=mvindex(split(pairs,"="),1), index_family=if(isnull(fams) OR fams="","(none)",split(fams,",")) | mvexpand index_family | join type=left uhgid index_family [| inputlookup dc_observed_lookup | `dc_key` | `dc_index_family` | where isnotnull(index_family) | stats max(last_seen) as last_seen, values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes_seen by uhgid index_family] | eval check=case(index_family="(none)","No index family in the standard - check by hand", isnull(uhgid) OR uhgid="","No UHGID on the request", isnull(last_seen),"Not arriving yet", now()-last_seen>86400,"Arrived before, silent 24h+", 1=1,"Flowing") | eval last_seen=if(isnull(last_seen),"",strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), sourcetypes_seen=mvjoin(sourcetypes_seen,", ") | table request_id system_name ae_name uhgid status technology index_family check last_seen sourcetypes_seen | sort request_id technology

format.colorPalette: {"Flowing":#53A051,"Not arriving yet":#F8BE34,"Arrived before, silent 24h+":#DC4E41,"No UHGID on the request":#F1813F}
